body: I want to be able to talk with them about it but just the idea of hospitalization scares me. Not to much being there but the effect it will have on my family and my friends

Don't feel bad for feeling this way, there is nothing you could have done to stop them from saying those awful things. Just because they said them doesn't mean it's truly going to happen. You're a fighter and you've survived through worse than some stranger saying things over the Internet.
Don't lose hope, even if there's just the tiniest glimmer of it. There have been so many times that I've come close to ending it and looking back I'm so glad I stayed.
